escenas.texto: Which was the most liked video in Europe this week? Here is the podium. Watch until the end.
In third place, ATTEMPTING TO FIX THE MISFIRING BUGATTI CHIRON, by Mat Armstrong MK2, with over 197 thousand likes.
In second place, पड़ोसन ने उड़ाया कच्ची मूली का मज़ाक, बहू ने ऐसे जीती…, by PORTIA AI STORY LITH, with over 298 thousand likes.
And number one: Did GTA 6 Finally Fix BLOCKED Car Doors?, by Mr Spring, with over 303 thousand likes.
The full countdown, from ten to one, is already on the channel. Find it in the description. Hashtag Top 10 RS.
